About This Workshop

Join us for an intensive one-day workshop on social media analytics and digital marketing. This comprehensive program covers advanced analytics techniques, cloud computing fundamentals, and modern digital marketing strategies used by industry leaders. Learn how to interpret social media data, optimize campaigns, and leverage cloud technologies for scalable solutions.

Whether you're a student looking to enhance your skills or a professional seeking professional development, this workshop offers practical insights and hands-on experience with industry-standard tools and platforms.
